user.title: Add DHL Packstation or DeinFach
user.description: Shows available locker compartments by size (S, M, L, XL) and total. Updates every 15 minutes. Choose Packstation or DeinFach and enter the five-digit postal code and three-digit station number. Your personal DHL Postnumber is not used. Add the integration again for more stations. Leading zeros in postal codes are supported.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read live compartment data. Check the station type, postal code and station number.
error.not_found: Station not found. Check the station type, postal code and station number.
error.wrong_station: DHL returned a different postal code or station number.
error.invalid_postal_code: Enter exactly five digits (0–9) for the postal code.
error.invalid_station_number: Enter exactly three digits (0–9) for the station number.
